Hay

Back to materials database

Hay is chicken feed. Official pre-EA notes say wild grass yields it at any growth stage; because that predates Early Access, verify a small test in your current save. A current-build bush/container route remains a single-player lead.

When you need it

When chickens arrive, first try cutting a small patch of wild grass; official Alpha notes say growth stage does not matter, but this has not been reverified in the current Early Access build. If that fails, a current-build report suggests bushes and NPC-farm crates/barrels, not a guaranteed drop table.

Sources and evidence

  • Official 2023 Alpha update notes say wild grass produces Hay regardless of growth stage. This is pre-Early Access documentation and does not by itself confirm current-build behavior. Official

    Source: The Ranchers, Ranching v2 update! (official Steam announcement) · Build: alpha-2023

  • An official moderator answer identifies hay as chicken feed; place it in the interior trough or load a connected silo for automation. Official

    Source: Steam thread: Chicken Feed (official moderator answer) · local archive · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • One current-build report gets hay by cutting bushes or searching crates and barrels on NPC farms. Treat this as a route to test, not a guaranteed drop table. Single-source lead

    Source: Steam thread: where can I find hay (single current-build report) · local archive · Build: 0.8.10.x

Uses in current entries

  • Coop × 15 (recorded shop offer)
